## About
Double D Landscapes was started by Doug Andrews, who grew up in a family landscape business in San Antonio and spent his career with the Texas A&M AgriLife Extension Service before opening Double D in North Dallas.
Tom Linden worked for Doug as a manager and designer, went on to build Green Man Landscaping out of Windsong Ranch, and later came back to buy Double D and bring Green Man Landscaping and Double D together. Today Tom and his crew handle design, installation and maintenance from right here in Prosper.
We're rated 5 from 43 Google reviews, and reviewers tend to mention Tom by name.

## Services
- Landscape Design: Free photogrammetric plans for your landscape, irrigation and outdoor lighting, plus virtual reality tours of your new design.
- Landscape Installation: Softscapes, hardscapes, stonework and structural landscaping, built from the plan we draw up together.
- Sod Installation: New sod as part of a full install or on its own. One reviewer had rock around the beds, new landscaping and sod put in.
- Stonework: Stone around trees and flower beds, and front and back masonry.
- Outdoor Lighting: Mood lighting, uplighting, downlighting and path lights with energy-efficient fixtures.
- Stone / Brick Patios & Driveways: Stone and brick patios and driveways.
- Arbor / Patio Cover / Pergola: Shade and structure for the backyard.
- Planter / Flower Beds: New planters and flower beds, laid out to fit the rest of the yard.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: Prosper and the North Dallas area, including McKinney, Frisco, Allen, Plano, Richardson, Carrollton, Little Elm, The Colony, Celina, Fairview, Melissa, Anna and Flower Mound.

Q: Do you charge for the design plan?
A: No. Our design plans for lighting and irrigation are free, and we offer virtual reality tours so you can see the yard before we start.

Q: Do you take care of the yard after it's built?
A: Yes. We offer lawn care and mowing, weed control, fertilization and hedge and shrub trimming.

Q: How do I get started?
A: Give us a call, schedule a consultation or use the online form.
